name: fp8_mqa_logits_n_heads32
description: The DSA indexer's prefill logits: for query row r and key c in [cu_starts[r], cu_ends[r]), logits[r, c] = kv_scales[c] * sum over heads h of weights[r, h] * relu(q[r, h] . kv[c]), written in place; logits outside a row's window keep their values.

n_q.description: Query rows, every request's back to back.

n_k.description: Keys, every request's back to back.

n_cols.description: Logits per row: the keys rounded up as aiter allocates them.

kv.description: The keys, one fp8 row each.

kv_scales.description: Each key's fp32 scale, positive: aiter applies it before relu.

cu_ends.description: Each row's end: its first key past the window.

logits.description: The rows' logits, written in place inside each row's window.

no_values.description: No values: the op's one result is logits, and a contract declares an output.
